---
title: STOAT summary report
---

```{r include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=10)
```

```{r}
library(StoatPlot)
library(ggplot2)

## path to association file (~stoat.assoc.pvalues.tsv.gz)
assoc_file = {{assoc_file}}

## import association results
assoc = import_assoc(assoc_file)
```

## Summary

```{r}
summary_stoat(assoc)
```

## QQ-plot

```{r qqplot, fig.width=7, fig.height=6}
qq_plot(assoc)
```

## Manhattan plot

```{r manhplot, fig.width=15, fig.height=5}
manhattan_plot(assoc)
```
